name: li-tax-overview
description: Route 2026 Liechtenstein tax questions to the right skill and give the headline figures. Covers the tax system at a glance: calendar tax year, Swiss franc, the Steuerverwaltung, who is taxed on what, individual wealth-and-income tax (state tax 0% up to a basic allowance, then 1% to 8%, plus a municipal surcharge of 150% to 250% of state tax, 4% deemed yield on wealth), corporate income tax (12.5%, CHF 1,800 minimum tax), VAT (8.1%, 2.6%, 3.8%, common VAT territory with Switzerland), social contributions (AHV/IV/FAK, ALV), payroll withholding, transfer pricing, cross-border rules and company formation. Trigger on: Liechtenstein tax overview, taxes in Liechtenstein, how is Liechtenstein taxed, Steuern Liechtenstein. It gives no standalone liability calculation; each linked skill holds the rules, sources and worked examples.
